A1.justification: Both PDFs describe FUSAR-GPT and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, references, and supplementary Sections 7–10. Their corresponding material can be reliably matched.

before.justification: V3 reports original SAR counting, localization, classification, detection, and captioning results, plus component and fusion-strategy ablations in the supplement.

after.justification: V4 retains these original empirical evaluations and ablations, including the corrected full-model counting result in Table 9.

M1.justification: V3 Section 3.3 and Equations 12–13 specify MLP-only Stage 1 training, whereas its Figure 2 already specifies joint MLP–LoRA training. V4 makes the detailed description joint and explicitly carries the adapters into Stage 2. This resolves conflicting descriptions, but the PDFs cannot establish whether the underlying procedure changed or its documentation was corrected.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same FUSAR-GEOVL-derived SAR/AEF data and retain counting, grid localization, coarse- and fine-grained classification, detection, and captioning. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the corresponding main and supplementary comparisons, including ChatGPT-5.2, Gemini-3, and R3Det. The change from 'R3det' to 'R3Det' in Table 8 is capitalization only.

E3.justification: Section 4.2 replaces evaluation of all baselines using their default parameters with fine-tuning under the same parameter settings as FUSAR-GPT. This substantially revises the stated controls across the comparisons. The unchanged comparison scores do not establish that experiments were rerun; other stated budgets, metrics, and preprocessing remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The existing Section 9 ablation of SFT1, SFT2, and TLM receives corrected full-model evidence and a corrected marginal SFT1 gain. Its component combinations are unchanged, as are the fusion-strategy comparisons and training-curve analyses; no new robustness or sensitivity experiment appears.

E5.justification: Figure 5 retains identical curves and shaded bands. Neither version adds run counts, seeds, explanations of uncertainty bands, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 9 changes full-model counting accuracy from 52.23 to 52.53, matching the 52.53 already reported in Tables 2, 5, and 6. Section 9 changes the claimed gain over 41.92 from approximately 2 to approximately 10 percentage points. Other scores and rankings are unchanged; this is a reporting correction rather than demonstrated new performance.

T1.justification: Section 3.3 explicitly adds LoRA to the parameter decomposition, and Equations 12–13 add its parameters to the Stage 1 likelihood and joint optimization domain. This corrects the formal training specification, beyond equivalent notation. No theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same triplet-data, AEF-prior, TLM, two-stage training, and performance claims. Replacing 'dual-stage' with 'two-stage' does not change their meaning.

C2.justification: Section 3.3 now attributes learning the Stage 1 semantic alignment jointly to the MLP and LoRA adapters rather than the MLP alone. Interpretations of AEF compensation and SFT1–TLM synergy, the absence of explicit temporal modeling, and the preliminary nature of detector evaluation remain unchanged.

D1.justification: V4 clarifies the trainable parameter groups and explicitly states that Stage 2 continues the LoRA adapters obtained in Stage 1. Hardware, epochs, learning rates, LoRA rank and scaling, optimizer, precision, and inference tools remain unchanged. No code or data access information is added.

R1.justification: The bibliography and substantive related-work and novelty positioning are unchanged. Removing the unfinished '(citing SAR-CLIP)' parenthesis in Section 4.3 is editorial; SAR-CLIP remains cited, discussed, and evaluated.

P1.justification: V4 locally rewrites the training and baseline-protocol paragraphs, expands the first affiliation, standardizes terminology, and fixes headings, grammar, coordinate labels, and ordinal indices. The section order and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: All eight figure artworks and nine table structures are retained. Caption corrections and modest text reflow alter presentation, including Table 2's vertical placement and the start of Section 4 moving from page 6 to page 7. There is no substantial redesign.

improvement.justification: V4 improves internal consistency by aligning the detailed Stage 1 formulation with the existing Figure 2 and correcting Table 9 and its accompanying arithmetic. Editorial fixes also improve readability. The revised baseline-protocol statement does not establish reruns or stronger empirical evidence, so the supported overall gain is limited.
